scope: JDK 21 standard ImageIO reader formats and JAXP DOM parser were inspected. ImageIO lists BMP, GIF, JPEG, PNG, TIFF, and WBMP, with no bundled SVG reader. DocumentBuilder parses generic XML and does not implement SVG shapes or rendering. No format-aware SVG parser is documented in these scoped Java SE APIs. The bare-JDK ImageIO probe is replayed on the valid SVG control; third-party classpath providers are excluded from that probe.
